annotations.title: Ask for access to all tabs

description: Ask the user for bypass mode, which gives you every open tab in the browser instead of only the shared ones. The browser shows the user a prompt with your reason and waits up to two minutes for an answer. Only ask when the task needs other tabs.

reason.description: One sentence the user will read, saying why you need the other tabs.
